source_name: Minneapolis Crime_Data feature service plus official crime dashboard/document anchors
analyst_notes: Minneapolis is now ready offense-selectively for murder, robbery, aggravated_assault, burglary, larceny, and motor_vehicle_theft. Keep rape blocked because the public feed collapses sex-offense codes into a generic Sex Offenses bucket rather than a strict repo rape category, and reconcile the six promotable offenses on row count rather than Crime_Count.

Official SLMPD monthly 2024 NIBRS CSVs expose direct coordinates and NIBRS offense codes for all seven Part-I families. Use 09A murder; 11A/11B/11C rape; 120 robbery; 13A aggravated assault; 220 burglary; 23A-23H larceny; and 240 motor vehicle theft. The public monthly files re-emit supplemented incidents, so the stable public dedupe key is IncidentNum plus NIBRS/offense/location/coordinates; a VictimNum-inclusive key was audited and rejected because it overcounts multiple offenses against the annual control. Incident rows are share-lane inputs only unless an offense clears the strict reconciliation gate against the CIUS/control-lane official 2024 St. Louis city total.
